name: Gang Hierarchy
text: Marks the fighter as part of the command structure (Leader or Champion). It carries Leading by Example, with range 12 inches for a Leader and 6 inches for a Champion.

name: Gang Leader
text: The one fighter every gang must have. If it is lost, a replacement is chosen from the gang (campaign).

name: Leading by Example
text: After the gang bottles out, if this fighter passes its Cool test to stay on the battlefield, friendly fighters within range pass automatically (12 inches for a Leader, 6 for a Champion, and a Champion only helps fighters without this rule). Resolved by the End phase; nothing declarative to attach.

name: Group Activation (X)
text: When this fighter activates, up to X more Ready friendly fighters within 3 inches may activate with it. All are nominated first, then each acts in full. A Leader or Champion brought in this way cannot start its own group.

name: Tools of the Trade
text: Campaign rule that lets the fighter keep several equipment sets and use one per battle. A skirmish gang has one set, so it has no effect.

name: Gang Fighter
text: Counts towards the rule that at least half of the gang must be Gang Fighters (Gangers, Specialists, Juves and Prospects).

name: Fast Learner
text: Campaign rule that makes advancement cheaper for Juves and Prospects. No skirmish effect.

name: Promotion
text: Campaign rule giving the fighter an upgrade path after enough advancements. No skirmish effect.

name: Hot-headed
text: When this fighter is Seriously Injured or goes Out of Action, its friends skip the Nerve test they would normally take for it; fighters of the same Hot-headed type still take it.
